description: Spend a balance on one menu item (fuel_menu lists them). The OWNER's turn only — an agent's own turn is refused. Draws the item's USD price from the balance (Rokha's fee part burns only when $ROKHA funded it) and applies the effect; if the effect cannot be applied nothing is charged. Confirm the item and price with the owner before calling — it spends their balance.

item.description: A menu item id from fuel_menu.

tank_id.description: Which of the caller's balances pays (fuel_status lists them). Omit for the caller's own balance.

target.description: The item's target when it needs one (scout_run: a Solana mint address).

wallet_address.description: The caller's owner identity (injected from context).

name: fuel_spend
title: Fuel Spend
